_doc: Named missing-trial test set for SEARCH RECALL -- the eligible trials the adversarial audits identified as missing from each topic's pool, each tagged with the RECOVERY MECHANISM that should retrieve it. Unaided recall against this set is the project's headline search metric: no published meta-analysis reports a cold-start recall number against a named adversarial test set about itself. Search is MEASURED against this, never declared 'solved'. Identifiers marked pending are under external verification (CT.gov/PubMed/EuropePMC) by a read-only session; a trial's presence here does not assert its PMID, it asserts the audit judged it eligible-and-missing.
headline_metric: unaided_recall = (test-set trials the rebuilt search retrieves without being told the PMID) / (test-set size)

recall_denominator._doc: The headline unaided-recall metric may ONLY be computed against SOURCE_VERIFIED_ELIGIBLE entries -- measuring search against an unverified list reproduces the failure we document (DIAMOND was on the list but is out-of-scope).
recall_denominator.baseline_unaided_recall: 0 of 6 -- every source-verified-eligible entry is a CONFIRMED MISS of the current (enumeration/RAN_ERROR) search; recall becomes measurable only after a search REBUILD (deferred).
